objective_contribution: Test reusable zero-token effect-evidence closure on GLM-5.3-flash 8K with exact same-trajectory baseline.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does zero-token pinned-base effect closure clear the fixed 8K development gate without stochastic branch noise?

measurement_mapping.native: Score baseline model IDs and closed final IDs on all 24 scheduled trajectories.
measurement_mapping.retention: Audit receipt-bound pinned-base effect overlap and six-item cap.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Reconstruct both outcomes from one validated response; reject export or source-binding defects.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Both outcomes share the exact model receipts; closure adds zero model input plus output tokens.
measurement_mapping.transfer: Development cannot establish untouched, larger-window, other-model, domain, or repair transfer.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window chapter before larger windows
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Same exposed eight tasks, three fresh identities each; confirmation untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: One frozen run; no reruns or changes.

retained_counterevidence: Round 20 quality/token signal failed validity and exposure.
Rounds 21-26 showed stochastic paired branches obscure small deterministic effects.
Round 28 was stopped because closure did not cover early terminal responses and admitted current evidence.
Exposed k=6 replay gained +3.63 scheduled and +4.84 all-executed Span-F1, below the +5 threshold under historical missingness.
successor_rule: Pass advances to untouched confirmation; fail closes H47 and returns to competing hypotheses.
